replace: // measured without clearing the width it set last time
why: Issue #706. The equalizer stops clearing `--hud-menu-col` before it measures, so each button reports the width it was last given rather than the width its label needs. A row can then only grow: at Pause, Settings alone keeps the 143 px Developer Tools width from the Main Menu a moment before, and a row with nothing visible keeps its stale width. Killed by the stale-width case and the nothing-visible case.
killedBy: menu-row-width.ts: one width per Main Menu row (issue #706) measures the labels, not the width it gave them last time
menu-row-width.ts: one width per Main Menu row (issue #706) clears the width when nothing in the row is visible
